title: Finite module tests from universal tensor acyclicity
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe, J a Grothendieck topology, R a sheaf of commutative rings, p a point of Sh(C,J), and s a normalized ringed-site point [def-sfb-ringed-site-point], with stalk ring A and module functor S. Let E be an unbounded module complex such that Tot(F tensor_R E) is acyclic for every complex F. For every finitely presented A-module M, Tot(S(E) tensor_A M[0]) is acyclic.

source.place: Tag 0DEN, proof of (1), the finite-presentation tensor test

proof.text: Realize M as a retract of S(F) for a global module sheaf F by the universal finite matrix construction.

The hypothesis applied to F[0] gives an acyclic tensor. Exactness of S preserves it, and its signed tensor comparison and compatibility with degree-zero complexes identify the image with S(F)[0] tensor S(E). Signed symmetry changes the order to S(E) tensor S(F)[0].

Apply the single-degree functor, tensor with S(E), and each homology functor to the retract. Each homology of S(E) tensor M[0] is a retract of zero, so its identity is zero and it is a zero object. Thus the desired complex is acyclic.

theorem acyclic_tensor_finitePresentation
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}}
    {p : GeometricMorphism (Type w) (Sheaf J (Type w))}
    (s : RingedSitePoint R p)
    (E : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hE : letI := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
      letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_independentCoefficients R
      letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj_independentCoefficients R
      ∀ F : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w}
        ((sheafCompose J
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ,
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor F E (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (M : ModuleCat.{w} s.ring) (hM : Module.FinitePresentation s.ring M) :
    (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor
      ((s.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj E)
      ((HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{w} s.ring) (.up ℤ) 0).obj M)
      (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic
